commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jarred Gillett who sees an offensive foul.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 30439.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Wilson Odobert (Burnley) is brought on as a substitute for Vitinho.
90+2' Substitution. Nathan Redmond (Burnley) on for Hjalmar Ekdal.
90+1' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Hugo Bueno is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The game is interrupted now, Hugo Bueno (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Boubacar Traore (Wolves) is coming onto the pitch as Matheus Cunha cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' The ball is cleared after Hugo Bueno (Wolves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
85' Sander Berge (Burnley) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jarred Gillett has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
85' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
83' Joao Gomes (Wolves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
82' Burnley take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
81' Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range. The ball is out of play. Burnley win a corner kick.
80' Max Kilman (Wolves) has tested the patience of referee Jarred Gillett and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
79' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Pablo Sarabia will be replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).

79' Vitinho (Burnley) unleashed a long-range shot, but it misses narrowly over the bar. It could have been the goal of the month, at least. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
78' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' The corner kick from Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
77' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper is equal to it.
76' Vitinho (Burnley) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
75' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
75' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) commits a rough foul. Jarred Gillett stops the game and makes a call.
74' Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
72' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
70' Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jacob Bruun Larsen.
70' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
70' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for James Trafford to dive and make a save.
68' Sander Berge (Burnley) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
67' Toti (Wolves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
67' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
65' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) was too forceful with his tackle and Jarred Gillett interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
65' Flag goes up against Mario Lemina (Wolves) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
64' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
63' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) makes a strong challenge and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
62' Craig Dawson (Wolves) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
62' Wolves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
61' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

59' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
57' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Mario Lemina (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
56' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
54' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Mario Lemina (Wolves), who plants a header just over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
53' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sander Berge (Burnley) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Vitinho (Burnley) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
51' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
50' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' The game is interrupted. Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
48' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jarred Gillett saw the whole situation.
48' Some neat passing and movement from Burnley as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' A dangerous looking corner kick from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45+4' Mario Lemina (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+3' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) touches the ball with his hand.
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Matheus Cunha provides Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
41' The referee blows his whistle as Sander Berge (Burnley) was too aggressive in his challenge.
39' A quickly taken corner by Burnley.

39' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
39' A fine pass finds Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Daniel Bentley reacts superbly to deny him.
36' Vincent Kompany is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Luca Koleosho suffers an injury and Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) comes on.

35' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
34' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
33' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle. Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) commits a foul after dangerous play.
32' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort low towards the middle of the goal and Daniel Bentley easily makes the save.
30' Jarred Gillett has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sander Berge (Burnley).
30' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
29' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
28' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
26' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
25' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but James Trafford has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

25' A rebound falls at the feet of Charlie Taylor (Burnley) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
24' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) leaps like a salmon to produce a header from the resulting corner, but one of the defending players intercepts the ball and averts the danger.
24' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) takes the corner.
22' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is caught offside!
20' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
19' Burnley take a short corner kick.
18' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
18' The percentage of ball possession is – 73:27.
15' Dangerous play by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley). Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Wolves are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
11' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Wolves players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
4' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
3' Max Kilman (Wolves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
2' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
1' Rough tackle by Luca Koleosho (Burnley). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will officiate today.
